title: Rossi dominates at Suzuka: flawless performance in Round 4
body: Marco Rossi takes his second win of the season with an impeccable lights-to-flag drive from pole position. Bianchi finishes second while Esposito completes the podium after charging from sixth.

title: Rossi extends championship lead: +18 points over Bianchi after Suzuka
body: After four rounds the leader consolidates his position. Three drivers are separated by just 7 points in the fight for second.

title: Qualifying format update: Q1/Q2 from Round 5
body: Q1 (10 min) open to all drivers, top 8 advance to Q2 (8 min). Full details available in the Regulations section.

title: Round 5 confirmed: Spa-Francorchamps on January 25th
body: The next round heads to the legendary Belgian circuit. Race start confirmed at 21:00 CET.

title: Round 3 — Monza: Esposito snatches victory on the final lap
body: A thrilling race at the Temple of Speed. Esposito overtakes Bianchi at the final corner on the last lap to claim a dramatic win.

title: Welcome to Season 2025 — Regulations now live
body: The new season is officially open. The full regulations are available in the dedicated section. Registration open until December 10th.
